name: clawd-hud
description: A pixel spark above the prompt with usage batteries (personal or enterprise), a prompt-cache timer and a context meter by the model picker

plan.title: Plan
plan.description: Which limits to show: personal (5h + weekly) or enterprise (weekly + monthly spend + $ cost). auto switches to enterprise when the account reports a spend limit

cacheTtl.title: Prompt cache TTL
cacheTtl.description: How long the prompt cache lives after each request. auto is 1h on personal plans and 5m on enterprise
